description: This file defines an interface IMedia and a template class Media within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides an abstraction for media communication, including methods for opening, closing, resetting, reading, and writing data, as well as internal handling of data transfer via a nested Handler class. The file includes licensing information, include guards, and dependencies on other modules.

classes.name: IMedia
classes.description: An interface defining basic media operations such as remote ID retrieval, open, close, reset, read, and write.

classes.name: Media
classes.description: A template class implementing IMedia, managing media data transfer with internal synchronization and a nested Handler class for source-specific behavior.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: A nested class within Media that extends SOURCE, providing mechanisms for state change notifications and data transmission.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier for the media.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the media channel, waiting up to waitTime.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the media channel, waiting up to waitTime.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the media, aborting ongoing operations if necessary.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the media within a specified duration.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the media within a specified duration.

methods.name: Source
methods.description: Provides access to the source handler of the media.

methods.name: Reevaluate
methods.description: Signals the media to reevaluate its state.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Transfers data from the send buffer to the media.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the media into the receive buffer.
